rows.description: The wolfSSL library is a small, fast, portable implementation of TLS/SSL for embedded devices to the cloud.  wolfSSL supports up to TLS 1.3 and DTLS 1.3! Update to wolfSSL 5.9.1 for the latest CVE fixes.
